description_sq:
Kompleksi Magnet, Apartament 2+1 per shitje.
175,000 €
Ne nje nga komplekset familjare me te kerkuar ne Tirane ofrojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 2+1.
Me nje siperfaqe totale 68 m2 por e mireshfrytezuar ne cdo pjese te saj apartamenti organizohet si me poshte:
-Sallon se bashku me kendin e gatimit
-2 dhoma gjumi
-1 tualet
-Ballkon
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne katin e 10 (i parafundit) me pamje te lire nga veri-lindja dhe shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor
Kompleksi Magnet eshte nje nga komplekset me te kerkuar per jetesen familjare duke perfshire cdo fasilitet te mundshem per nje jetese sa me komode.
Kerkesa e larte per banim dhe per qiramarrje gjithashtu e bejne kete prone ideale si per banim ashtu dhe per investim.
Me kontaktoni per nje vizite ne prone.
description_en: Magnet complex, 2+1 apartment for sale. €175,000 In one of the most sought-after family complexes in Tirana, we offer for sale a 2+1 apartment. With a total area of ​​68 m2 but well-utilized in every part, the apartment is organized as follows: - Living room with kitchenette - 2 bedrooms - 1 bathroom - Balcony The apartment is located on the 10th floor (penultimate) with a clear view from the north-east and is sold furnished as in the photo. It has regular mortgage documentation. The Magnet complex is one of the most sought-after complexes for family living, including every possible facility for a comfortable life. The high demand for housing and renting also makes this property ideal for both housing and investment. Contact me for a visit to the property.
